acceptanceCriteria: ticket create result reports the new ticketId, revision and receipt reference.
A CLI test asserts the ID on create and that a request-id replay reports the same ID.
body:
Reproduction: `corvint-tasks ticket create --request-id ID --role OWNER --payload-stdin < payload.json`. Actual result shape (verbatim keys): {"codes":[],"command":["ticket","create"],"items":[...],"mutation":null,"outcome":"OK","page":null,"profile":"taskman-command-result/0","snapshot":null,"untrusted":[],"warnings":["the actor binding is a recorded local-operator claim, not an authentication (decision 0003); a real queue still needs the section 7.4 cutover record"]}. The only warning is that actor-binding text; the new ticket ID is not reported, so callers must search by title to find it (15 creates in a batch). Expected: mutation (or items) reports the created ticketId and revision. Related: V1-0628 (create cannot set a meaningful ID).

Source: batch 4 lanes for GitHub #641-#647, 2026-10-06 (branches claude/v1-0645-audit-outside-lock, claude/scale-tasks-v1-0893, claude/scale-core-v1-0416, claude/gh644-live-upgrade). Darwin 25.6.0, go1.27.1. Versions: corvint-tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202; corvint 1.0.0-rc.2 (build 360).
title: corvint-tasks ticket create returns mutation null, so the created ticket ID is not reported
